proposal.risk_audit: All formulas unit-checked dimensionless (Pk/eps; UgradP*d/(k*Umag) = [L3/T3]/[L3/T3]; (W-S)/(W+S+omega) = [1/T]/[1/T]). Finite: Pk/eps uses eps>0 denominator, only 0/0 if eps=0 (<1% points); APG 0/0 only at exact wall d=Umag=k=0, cell-centers finite though large, mapping x/(|x|+median) compresses extremes; curvature denominator W+S+omega>0 strictly via omega>0 so 100% finite. No duplication of I1/I2: noneq adds signed production vs dissipation, APG adds pressure-work direction, curvature adds rotation-vs-strain sign. Risk of Pk/eps correlating with I1 mitigated by signed backscatter (Pk<0) in separation.

features.name: f_curv

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless by L-T check (numerator and denominator scale identically under V->2V, L->3L). Denominators are >0 in interior (eps>0, Snorm+omega>0, Umag+omega*d>0); 0/0 only at wall/stagnation where Umag=k=d=0, expected <1% points so finite>=99% holds like f_apg. Orderings are distinct from f_noneq/f_apg/f_curv: advection vs local, acceleration vs shear, wall vs outer. Bounded or mildly scaled to avoid outliers; no log/exp blow-up. Retain f_apg/f_curv despite 0 gain: ample slots (7 free), APG/curvature physically critical for worst heldout converging_diverging_channel and bumps, one-round gain is noisy.

features.name: f_adv

features.name: f_acc

features.name: f_wall

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 features checked dimensionless under V->2V, L->3L (numerator and denominator scale identically). Finite: f_apg2 denom abs(UgradP)+eps>0 as eps>0 (0 only if eps=0, <1% points); f_pbal denom DUDt+gradp+omega*Umag>0 except possible wall zero-PG stagnation (volume fraction <1%, passes 99% rule, ordering preserved by median scaling); f_tdif denom k+eps/(Snorm+omega)>0 strictly since eps>0 and Snorm+omega>0, so 100% finite. Not constant (signed APG, pressure-vs-inertia, k-transport all vary). Redundancy risk low: f_apg2 bounded signed APG complements unbounded f_noneq=Pk/eps and replaces noisy f_apg (singular 1/y at wall); f_pbal unsigned pressure dominance complements f_acc without Umag=0 singularity in numerator; f_tdif adds wall-normal turbulent transport missing from I1/I2/f_adv. Drop f_apg,f_curv,f_adv with heldout_gain=0 to free slots; keep f_noneq,f_acc,f_wall which are used.

features.name: f_tdif

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless under U->2U L->3L (1/T scales 2/3, L^2/T^2 scales 4, L^2/T^3 scales 8/3): f_curv (1/T)/(1/T), f_kadv (L^2/T^3)/(L^2/T^3), f_lim (L^2/T^2)/(L^2/T^2). Denominators >0 off-wall (omega>0, eps>0, k+nut*(.)>0 at cell centers) so finite ~100%, varying, bounded to aid search. They complement f_noneq/f_acc/f_wall (shear magnitude/history, acceleration, wall marker) with rotation-vs-strain curvature for bump/channel separation, signed k-advection for growing vs decaying bubble/reattachment, and SST limiter activation where nut deviates from k/omega. Drop f_apg2/f_pbal/f_tdif (0 gain, 0 terms) to reduce search space; keep f_wall despite tiny gain because it is used.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked dimensionless under U->2U, L->3L (numerator and denominator scale identically). Denominators use eps>0 or sqrt(k)*omega>0 or k>0 so finite on ~100% of points; formulas use only allowed ops and are non-constant orderings. f_apg gives signed APG/FPG direction missing from active set; f_pgrad gives APG magnitude vs inertia/turbulence; f_aniso gives baseline anisotropy magnitude to localize shear vs stagnation errors. Risk: f_pgrad and f_apg share gradp_mag so partially correlated, but direction vs magnitude are complementary; f_aniso may correlate with Pk/eps in shear layers but adds stagnation vs shear discrimination. Drop f_wall (heldout_gain -0.0209, harmful for held-out); retain f_noneq/f_curv/f_kadv with zero gain as they encode non-equilibrium/curvature history that may combine with new APG sensors once search explores interactions.
